in_marathi.name: Bibek
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wise, Intelligent, Thoughtful
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bibek हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'bibhak', meaning 'to discriminate'. Bibek is a name of great wisdom and intelligence, signifying the ability to discern truth from falsehood and make wise decisions. This name is deeply rooted in the Hindu tradition and is considered a symbol of knowledge and understanding.
